locations.label: Main Street radio
locations.description: Read the two-letter/number code above Main Street’s radio. In Church, find the pinned map region and use the adjacent frequency chart—or the tool—to obtain its letter band and model-number frequency. Enter band on the left dial and number frequency on the right. Green light and “Contacted the Russians” confirm success. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Basement Wunderbuss workbench
locations.description: Find the battery on a broken wallbuy box: Museum left of Armour, Museum right of Faustblitz or Cabaret right of M1928. Fit it into the fenced Apartments-basement generator. Enter, then remove the battery inside; the gate closes. Fit the battery and Geistbolt on the Wunderbuss table and claim the weapon. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Elevator Ubersprengen
locations.description: Use throwable explosives to blow open two metal panels: left of the Destroyed Building Waffe 28, and behind Underbelly bars right of the Destroyed Building door. S-Mines and Throwing Knife cannot expose these panels. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Cabaret clown projector
locations.description: Take the large woman’s painting in Apartments and fit it in front of Cabaret’s rear projector. Shoot down the reel above the projector, collect it and insert it. Charge the projector with Wunderbuss to reveal a map with one green active district. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Apartments safe
locations.description: At the Apartments safe, reset with three full clockwise rotations, counting a rotation each time you pass the first recorded number. Stop clockwise on number 1, counterclockwise on number 2, clockwise on number 3 and counterclockwise on number 4. Hold interact to exit the dial and claim the Dagger after it opens. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Church map / clue board
locations.description: Read the two-letter/number code above Main Street’s radio. In Church, find the pinned map region and use the adjacent frequency chart—or the tool—to obtain its letter band and model-number frequency. Enter band on the left dial and number frequency on the right. Green light and “Contacted the Russians” confirm success. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Upper Museum scales
locations.description: Take Cabaret’s magnifying glass beside the hat on the couch left of M1928. Interact with Church’s map and move the glass to the decoded clue’s position, using the numbered reference. Exit the map at the chosen spot; correct placement opens the cabinet with the bowl. Fit the bowl on the Museum upper-floor scale left of Combat Shotgun. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Refuge statue walls
locations.description: The three-statue wall left of the stairs is wall 1; count walls counterclockwise. Record each statue’s current facing in the solver: down means facing you, up means away. Shoot the returned minimum route for that wall. Shooting affects neighbours at the affected statue’s own rate, so changing walls requires fresh input. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Zeppelin departure pod
locations.description: After all three anchors are yellow, the Drop Pod hangs over Main Street. Upgrade a gun whose arena wallbuy can refill it—MP-40 or FG42 are available—and stock armour, perks and full Wunderbuss reserve. Dagger heavy attacks restore armour when already at full health. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
